cohort: A nationally representative sample of 3,609 under-five children from the 2019 Ethiopia Mini Demographic and Health Survey data set.
finding: Overweight or obesity among under-five children shows spatial variations across Ethiopian regions, with urban residence, cesarean section, wealth index, and child sex identified as significant predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a significant predictor of overweight/obesity among under-five children.
